perks.name: Kill Spree
perks.before:
When all Survivors have reached the second Hook Stage and all Generators have been completed, you can kill Survivors.
While killing a Survivor, Exit Gate Switches are blocked by The Entity and for 6/8/10 seconds after.
perks.after:
When all Survivors have reached the second Hook Stage and all Generators have been completed, you can kill Survivors.
While killing a Survivor, Exit Gate Switches are blocked by The Entity and for 12/18/20 seconds after.

perks.name: Scourge Hook: Monstrous Shrine
perks.before:
At the start of the Trial, the 4 Hooks located inside the Basement and an additional 4 Hooks located throughout the Trial Grounds are all changed into Scourge Hooks:
• The Auras of Scourge Hooks are highlighted to you in white.
Whenever you are farther than 24 metres from a Survivor hooked onto a Scourge Hook, the following effect applies:
• All Generators regress at 150/175/200% of the default Regression rate.
perks.after:
At the start of the Trial, the 4 Hooks located inside the Basement and an additional 4 Hooks located throughout the Trial Grounds are all changed into Scourge Hooks:
• The Auras of Scourge Hooks are highlighted to you in white.
Whenever you are farther than 24 metres from a Survivor hooked onto a Scourge Hook, the following effect applies:
• All Generators regress at +200% of the default Regression rate.
• This persists for 20/25/30 seconds after the Survivor is unhooked.

addons.name: Brooke's Pustule
addons.before:
• While standing in the Acid Puddle and for 5 seconds after, increase basic-breaking speed of Pallets and Breakable Walls by +25%.
• When you apply Torture, the next Bag of Toys search is guaranteed to contain the Acid Bottle.
addons.after:
• Increases the size of the Acid Puddle up to +100% based on the distance the Acid Bottle traveled, reaching the maximum at 6 metres.
• When you apply Torture, the next Bag of Toys search is guaranteed to contain the Acid Bottle.

addons.name: Explosive Gift
addons.before: • For each Toy with maximum Deadliness, reduce your Terror Radius size by -20%.
addons.after: • For each Toy with maximum Deadliness, reduce your Terror Radius size by -12%.

addons.name: Jonathan's Skull
addons.before:
• Damaging or Torturing a Survivor with a Toy grants 1 Token, up to 10 Tokens.
• Manually Taunting consumes all Tokens then, if at least 1 Token was consumed, reveal all Survivor auras within 8 metres plus +2 metres per Token for 6 seconds.
addons.after:
• Damaging or Torturing a Survivor with a Toy grants 1 Token, up to 5 Tokens.
• Manually Taunting consumes all Tokens then, if at least 1 Token was consumed, reveal all Survivor auras within 10 metres plus +5 metres per Token for 6 seconds.

addons.name: Duct Tape
addons.before: • Equipping a Toy within 0.5 seconds of opening the Bag of Toys reduces its cool-down by -5 seconds.
addons.after: • Equipping a Toy within 0.5 seconds of opening the Bag of Toys reduces its cool-down by -4 seconds.

perks.name: Calm Spirit
perks.before:
You experience the following effects during a Trial:
• Nearby Crows no longer fly off and alert others to your presence, unless you come within touching distance.
• Suppresses the urge to scream from any cause at all times.
• Suppresses all noises related to interacting with the following Props:
• Chests
• Totems
• Increases the Action speeds for Blessing, Cleansing, and Unlocking by 8/9/10%.
perks.after:
You experience the following effects during a Trial:
• Nearby Crows no longer fly off and alert others to your presence, unless you come within touching distance.
• Suppresses the urge to scream from any cause at all times.
• Suppresses all noises related to interacting with the following Props:
• Chests
• Totems
• Increases the Action speeds for Blessing, Cleansing, and Unlocking by 23/24/25%.

perks.name: Dark Sense
perks.before:
Unlocks potential in your Aura-reading ability.
Whenever a Generator is completed, Dark Sense activates:
• When the Killer gets within 24 metres of you, Dark Sense activates for 13/14/15 seconds:
• You see the Killer's aura.
• You see auras of other Survivors.
• You see the auras of Pallets and Windows within 32 metres.
Dark Sense deactivates after use.
perks.after:
Unlocks potential in your Aura-reading ability.
Dark Sense starts with and gains 1 Token whenever a Generator is completed. Dark Sense can hold up to 5 Tokens at once.
• When the Killer gets within 24 metres of you, Dark Sense consumes 1 Token and activates for 13/14/15 seconds:
• You see the Killer's aura.
• You see auras of other Survivors.
• You see the auras of Pallets and Windows within 32 metres.
Dark Sense deactivates after use.

perks.name: Five Moves Ahead
perks.before:
This perk activates while you are being chased by the Killer or are inside the Killer's Terror Radius:
• After you drop a Pallet, you start moving 50% earlier.
• See the auras of the 5 closest Pallets.
This perk goes on a 40/35/30 seconds cool-down when you drop a Pallet while this perk is activated.
perks.after:
Five Moves Ahead activates while you are being chased by the Killer or are inside the Killer's Terror Radius:
• After you drop a Pallet, you start moving 50% earlier.
• See the auras of the 5 closest Pallets.
Five Moves Ahead goes on a 40/35/30 seconds cool-down when you drop a Pallet.

perks.name: Lend a Hand
perks.before:
Cleansing or Blessing a Totem activates this perk:
• Once per Survivor, while healing a Survivor, press Activate Ability 2 to give the healed Survivor 2/3/4 permanent healing charges.
perks.after:
Cleansing or Blessing a Totem activates Lend a Hand:
• Once per Survivor, while healing a Survivor, press Activate Ability 2 to give the healed Survivor 2/3/4 permanent healing charges.

perks.name: Off the Record
perks.before:
After being unhooked or unhooking yourself, Off the Record activates for 30/35/40 seconds:
• Blocks your Aura from being revealed.
• Suppresses your Grunts of Pain while in the Injured State.
• Suppresses the creation of your Scratch Marks.
• Grants the Endurance Status Effect.
• Endurance is cancelled prematurely when performing a Conspicuous Action of any kind.
Off the Record deactivates prematurely and is disabled for the remainder of the Trial upon powering the Exit Gates.
perks.after:
After being unhooked or unhooking yourself, Off the Record activates for 30/35/40 seconds:
• Blocks your Aura from being revealed.
• Suppresses your Grunts of Pain while in the Injured State.
• Grants the Endurance Status Effect.
• Endurance is cancelled prematurely when performing a Conspicuous Action of any kind.
Off the Record deactivates prematurely and is disabled for the remainder of the Trial upon powering the Exit Gates.

perks.name: Slippery Meat
perks.before:
You have developed an efficient way to get off Hooks.
• Other Survivors unhook you 90/95/100% faster.
• Increases the Haste granted by Unhook Protections by +5%.
perks.after:
You have developed an efficient way to get off Hooks.
• Other Survivors unhook you 65/70/75% faster.
• Increases the Haste granted by Unhook Protections by +7%.

perks.name: Celestial Witness
perks.before: Every 30 seconds, if the Obsession is 40 metres away from you, you see their aura for 2/2.5/3 seconds. Otherwise, the farthest Survivor becomes the Obsession.
perks.after:
Every 30 seconds, if the Obsession is 40 metres away from you, you see their aura for 2/2.5/3 seconds.
Otherwise, the farthest Survivor becomes the Obsession.

Once you accumulate 4 Tokens, all Survivors suffer from the following effects:
• Causes them to scream.
• Inflicts the Exposed Status Effect for 80/85/90 seconds.
perks.after:
Whenever you hook a Survivor for the first time, Ravenous gains +1 Token, up to a maximum of 4 Tokens.
